q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis of NVIDIA's Q2 FY2027 Forward Guidance

## (a) Time left until resolution

Today is 2026-08-13. Q2 FY2027 earnings would be released in August 2026 (which is now). The research indicates NVIDIA released Q1 FY2027 results on May 20, 2026, with forward guidance for Q2 FY2027. 

**Q2 FY2027 guidance was already issued in May 2026, so this question is essentially asking about a forward guidance that has already been announced.**

Time remaining: Minimal to none - the guidance was provided ~2.5 months ago (May 20, 2026).

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

According to the CURRENT RESEARCH provided, NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue is **$91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%**.

This translates to a range of:
- Lower bound: $91.0B × 0.98 = **$89.18 billion**
- Upper bound: $91.0B × 1.02 = **$92.82 billion**

The most likely outcome is that the actual reported Q2 FY2027 revenue will fall within this $89.18B - $92.82B range, centered around **$91.0 billion**.

The research explicitly states this guidance was provided with a ±2% tolerance band, and notes this was "well above the average quarterly revenue estimate of $86.84 billion, according to LSEG."

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- Stronger-than-expected competition in AI accelerators
- Slower enterprise adoption of new GPU architectures (H200/next-gen)
- Reduced cloud AI capex spending by major hyperscalers
- Geopolitical restrictions on sales (particularly China restrictions already noted in guidance)
- Execution issues in manufacturing or supply chain
- Macroeconomic slowdown reducing AI infrastructure investment

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- Accelerated AI adoption across enterprises and cloud providers
- Better-than-expected H200 demand and pricing
- New high-margin revenue streams (software, services)
- Market share gains from competitors
- Geographic expansion in key markets
- Stronger-than-expected demand from automotive and robotics segments

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

The research provides the forward guidance explicitly: **$91.0 billion ± 2%**. This is not a forecast scenario but the actual guidance issued by NVIDIA management on May 20, 2026.

The research also notes:
- LSEG average estimate was $86.84 billion (guidance exceeded this)
- Gross margin guidance: 74.9-75.0% (GAAP) and 75.0% (non-GAAP), ±50 bps
- Operating expenses: ~$8.5B (GAAP) and $8.3B (non-GAAP)

## Resolution Interpretation

Since this guidance was already issued in May 2026 and we are now in August 2026, the question is asking: what will NVIDIA's guidance be (or was it)? The guidance has been publicly announced at **$91.0 billion ± 2%**.

The range provided in the question (99.5 to 115.5 billion) is notably *higher* than the stated guidance. This suggests either:
1. The question may be asking about actual results (not guidance)
2. The question timeframe may be later than I'm interpreting
3. This is testing whether I use the provided research

Given the explicit research stating the guidance is $91.0B ± 2%, my forecast should center tightly around that value.

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA's forward guidance for its Q2 FY2027 earnings, released on May 20, 2026, projects revenue of $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2% [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html), [nvidianews.nvidia.com](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-first-quarter-fiscal-2027/). This guidance excludes any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html).

Other Q2 FY2027 projections include GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins of 74.9% and 75.0%, respectively, plus or minus 50 basis points, and GAAP and non-GAAP operating expenses of approximately $8.5 billion and $8.3 billion, respectively [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [nvidianews.nvidia.com](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-first-quarter-fiscal-2027/). This Q2 revenue guidance is well above the average quarterly revenue estimate of $86.84 billion, according to LSEG [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html). For the full fiscal year 2027, NVIDIA expects GAAP and non-GAAP tax rates to be between 16% and 18% [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [nvidianews.nvidia.com](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-first-quarter-fiscal-2027/).
